edges.effect_quant: Pooled meta-analytic evidence point in more than one direction, so no single pooled effect estimate is reliable enough to summarize cleanly.
edges.mechanism: This factor changes substrate delivery, microbial competition, short-chain fatty-acid production, or early-life colonization patterns in the gut. Those changes are most directly linked to Allergic disease when the endpoint is microbial composition, barrier function, or a gut-mediated immune phenotype.
edges.summary: In children who were breastfed, pooled meta-analytic evidence suggest that breastfeeding tracks with mixed effects on allergic disease. Most disagreement in the literature is about size, subgroup sensitivity, or dose threshold rather than about whether the relationship exists at all.
edges.caveats: Dose, timing, and baseline risk still matter. Observational edges may partly reflect broader lifestyle patterning, while small trials can overstate benefit if follow-up is short.
